title: USP13 dictates Ran turnover and vulnerability to ferroptosis in diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL).
authors: Qiao, Xuan; Yang, Xingmeng; Diao, Yuanhao; Li, Qiuxiang; Wang, Xianhuo; Li, Chong; Yang, Zailin; Chng, Wee Joo; Li, Boheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究USP13去泛素化酶调控Ran蛋白稳定性及DLBCL铁死亡机制，虽用AlphaFold3建模蛋白互作，但核心是泛素化与肿瘤治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is one of the most common and lethal B-cell malignancies worldwide, with high relapse rate after standard treatment, and the relapsed cases are often difficult to treat. Ubiquitination has a pivotal role in cellular protein homeostasis and tumorigenic deubiquitinases (DUBs) stabilize oncoproteins during carcinogenesis. In this study, we have identified USP13 as one of the abnormally-overexpressed and stage-related DUBs in DLBCL critical to disease pathogenesis. Employing LC-MS/MS, Ran GTPase was characterized as potential substrate of USP13, with the interaction between Ran and USP13 modeled by Alphafold3. USP13 co-overexpressed, co-localized and correlated with Ran at protein level in DLBCL patient samples and cell lines. Pharmacological inhibition and genetic manipulation of USP13 modulated Ran protein stability and K11-linked ubiquitination level of Ran. By RNA-seq, pharmacological inhibition of USP13 via Spautin-1 treatment in DLBCL revealed downstream targets in NF-kappaB and Notch pathways. Suggested by the DRESIS Database, NF-kappaB and Notch signaling cascades are key to the resistance of Doxorubicin (Dox) and cyclophosphamide (CTX) within the standard R-CHOP regimen of DLBCL hinting benefits of combining Spautin-1 with Dox or CTX. Further in-vitro and in-vivo experiments confirmed Spautin-1 synergized with Dox or CTX to initiate ferroptosis in DLBCL with few toxicities to main organs by mediating ROS, GSH, MDA and ultimately LPO. Altogether, these results demonstrate USP13 deubiquitinates Ran in DLBCL, and Spautin-1 well synergizes with Dox or CTX to initiate ferroptosis. Combinational treatment with Spautin-1 and Dox or CTX may represent an effective approach and therapeutic hope to combat with DLBCL.
abstract_zh: 弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）是全球最常见且致命的B细胞恶性肿瘤之一，标准治疗后复发率高，且复发病例往往难以治疗。泛素化在细胞蛋白质稳态中起关键作用，而肿瘤性去泛素化酶（DUBs）在癌变过程中稳定致癌蛋白。在本研究中，我们鉴定出USP13是DLBCL中异常高表达且与分期相关的DUBs之一，对疾病发病机制至关重要。通过LC-MS/MS技术，Ran GTPase被表征为USP13的潜在底物，且Ran与USP13之间的相互作用通过Alphafold3进行了建模。在DLBCL患者样本和细胞系中，USP13与Ran在蛋白质水平上共过表达、共定位且相关。USP13的药理学抑制和遗传操作调节了Ran蛋白稳定性及Ran的K11连接泛素化水平。通过RNA-seq，在DLBCL中使用Spautin-1对USP13进行药理学抑制，揭示了NF-kappaB和Notch通路中的下游靶点。根据DRESIS数据库提示，NF-kappaB和Notch信号级联是标准R-CHOP方案中DLBCL对阿霉素（Dox）和环磷酰胺（CTX）耐药的关键，暗示将Spautin-1与Dox或CTX联合使用可能有益。进一步的体外和体内实验证实，Spautin-1与Dox或CTX协同作用，通过介导ROS、GSH、MDA并最终导致LPO，在DLBCL中启动铁死亡，且对主要器官毒性很小。总之，这些结果表明USP13在DLBCL中去泛素化Ran，且Spautin-1与Dox或CTX良好协同以启动铁死亡。Spautin-1与Dox或CTX的联合治疗可能代表一种对抗DLBCL的有效策略和治疗希望。
